name: plane
description: Open-source project management that unlocks customer value

scripts.clean: turbo run clean && rm -rf .turbo && rm -rf .next && rm -rf node_modules && rm -rf dist
scripts.fix:format: oxfmt package.json turbo.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json tools .github && turbo run fix:format
scripts.check:lint: pnpm check:toolchain && oxlint --deny-warnings tools && turbo run check:lint
scripts.check:format: oxfmt --check package.json turbo.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json tools .github && turbo run check:format
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @summon/convex test && pnpm --filter live test && pnpm --filter web test
